INSERT INTO account_research_pipeline_runs (
            organization_id,
            account_id,
            researched_account_id,
            trigger,
            status,
            started_at,
            finished_at
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'ENRICH_EXECUTION',
            ($4::text)::account_research_pipeline_run_status,
            CASE WHEN $5 THEN now() - interval '5 minutes' ELSE NULL END,
            CASE WHEN $6 THEN now() - interval '1 minute' ELSE NULL END
         )
